question: In which of the following year Gandhiji went to London for the Second Round Table conference?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1931**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Second Round Table Conference** was held in **London** from **September 1931** to **December 1931**.
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi** attended this conference as the sole representative of the **Indian National Congress (INC)**.
 
• His participation was a result of the **Gandhi-Irwin Pact**, signed on **5 March 1931**, which led to the suspension of the **Civil Disobedience Movement**.
 
• During the conference, **Gandhiji** stayed at **Kingsley Hall** and travelled to **England** on the ship **SS Rajputana**.
 
• The conference primarily discussed the constitutional future of **India**, but it failed to reach a consensus due to the deadlock over **separate electorates** for minorities, which **Gandhiji** strongly opposed.
